activity_summary: She heard the stair, and you said the back was eased. The tooth was not. You ate three bites and left the rest. You gave her the Knave and no name of a side. You went as billed. No order had come.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Said the back was eased, ate three bites, and went as billed.

entities.name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell
entities.context: Heard the stair, kept her verdict, and sent him out with the crust uneaten.

entities.name: Alse Pinder
entities.context: Heard the third tread from the copper, and left the water on the landing.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: On the third tread, and stepped over. Not at the board.

facets.activity: Ate three bites and went to the Knave

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The back is eased. I am not going to make a feast of it.

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: The Knave. At the Theatre. Two of the clock.
